newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-St George and Advance to merge.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-St George and Advance to merge.

text.p: Regional banks St George Bank Ltd and Advance Bank Ltd said on Monday they had agreed to a A$2.65 billion merger.
St George said it would offer A$7.30 for each Advance Bank share.
Advance Bank shares last traded at A$6.28.
Advance shareholders will be offered a combination of A$2.10 in cash, a 20 cent special cash dividend and new St George shares up to a value of A$5.00 per Advance Bank.
St George said the total value of this offer is A$7.30 per share, which represents a 20 percent increase over the average Advance Bank share price over the last five trading days.
St George said Advance shareholders will also receive an Advance Bank interim dividend, expected to be 20 cents, payable in February 1997.

St George said that based on its closing price of A$8.95 last Friday, it would have issued 209 million new shares to Advance Bank shareholders, or an exchange ratio of 0.575 St George shares for each Advance Bank share.
The total number of St George shares to be issued will be capped at a maximum of 227 million.

"As part of the merger implementation agreement, Advance Bank has agreed to reimburse St George Bank in certain ciricumstances for costs and losses, up to A$100 million, if Advance Bank is acquired by a third party," St George said.
